jobs.description: In this role, you will drive the efficiency of the global Stage-Gate process for product development across LIXIL's brands and regions. You are the operational engine behind our R&D delivery: ensuring clear work packages, disciplined gate transitions, and practical governance that project teams can easily adopt. As the primary subject matter expert, you will serve as the trusted advisor for project managers and gatekeepers on all process inquiries.The role works through influence across a matrixed, multi-cultural organisation and is a service to colleagues rather than an audit function. R&D is in active transformation on tooling and data quality, so ambiguity and shifting priorities are part of the job.Your Responsibilities:- Drive continuous optimisation of the global Stage-Gate Work Packages, ensuring deliverables are lean, consistent and harmonised across brands and regions.- Maintain and enforce the global R&D governance framework: processes, tools, RASCI models, cadence structures and compliance checkpoints.- Safeguard gate readiness, documentation integrity and audit readiness across all gate transitions.- Define, track and report R&D KPIs covering gate discipline, cycle time and pipeline health.- Develop and maintain digitalized templates, blueprints, work instructions and process documentation that simplify execution for project managers.- Coordinate cross-functional and cross-regional alignment, so local delivery conforms to global R&D standards.- Ensure Stage-Gate documentation and gate data are captured consistently and kept current in the governing systems, and represent process requirements towards the system owners.- Build and maintain the R&D Knowledge Hub as the single, topic-structured source for process documentation, templates and training material, curated as an ongoing exercise.- Ensure data continuity between Stage-Gate governance and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), acting as the business-side representative to translate process requirements into system specifications with the Global PLM team.Your Profile:- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Business Management, Industrial Management or comparable.- 7 to 10 years in process management, R&D project management or operational excellence, gained across more than one industry, ideally in product development or manufacturing.- Proven implementation of Stage-Gate or comparable phase-gate models- Working understanding of project and portfolio management systems used in an R&D environment (e.g. Planisware Orchestra, SAP) and good data literacy for KPI definition and process analysis.- Interest in how AI, automation and digital tools can simplify product development processes.- Solid understanding of PLM, ERP, and engineering change management systems (e.g., SAP, Planisware Orchestra), with the ability to align process governance with system architecture.- Demonstrated comfort, curiosity and respect across cultures and working styles is a core requirement.- Gives and receives feedback constructively.- Lean, Six Sigma or comparable optimisation approaches an advantage.- Strong moderation and stakeholder skills, able to steer cross-regional teams without direct reporting lines. Able to translate between technical detail and business framing.- Business-fluent English required, German an advantage.Our offer:- A salary package that ties directly to your work experience and responsibilities- Comprehensive health management, including an on-site fitness room, local and digital health services, Health Cashback, and Hansefit membership- Diversity & Inclusion: We offer equal opportunities for all individuals and support your personal development- Access to a wide range of employee benefits, such as discounts on travel, fashion, media, mobile phones, and more- A highly motivated, appreciative, and international team that inspires you and offers opportunities to learn and grow- A modern company restaurant to ensure your well-being during the dayInterested?Then we are looking forward to your application!

What to ExpectThe Bodyshop Technical Trainer position requires someone with exceptional ability to deliver learning solutions within their region. The Tesla Bodyshop Technical Trainer will take responsibility for ensuring our internal and external repair network is equipped to deliver the best ownership experience the world has ever seen for every Tesla owner. Key responsibilities include facilitating hands-on technical Onboarding and Continuous Bodyshop technical training, mentoring and supporting Bodyshop technicians, and partnering closely with local Bodyshop Managers and regional network managers to train for skill gaps and elevate the performance of their teams and regions.   This individual must be creative, proactive, organized, flexible, results-oriented, and have a passion for and understanding of electric vehicles. Must have outstanding communication, facilitation, and organizational skills while demonstrating a positive and professional demeanor.Please note that only 1 role/headscount is open, to be hired either in the UK or Germany.What You’ll Do- Facilitate Onboarding and Continuous instructor-led and virtual Bodyshop technical training on electric vehicles equipped with complex automotive and electromechanical systems to enable employees to perform their role safely and to Tesla’s standards- Maintain expert knowledge of the most current product knowledge, systems, methods, techniques, and best practices of Bodyshop repair procedure and processes  - Support the Content Development team with reviewing training material, as needed  - Support local apprentice programs as needed, including delivering training, supporting apprentice mentors, and reviewing training materials- Partner with Managers and Coaches to identify and train for skill gap development of employees- Serve, coach and mentor a network of Internal Bodyshop technicians and coaches to enhance core capabilities and ensure continuous process improvement- Support and manage any local and specific projects with minimal guidanceWhat You’ll Bring- Fluency in English is a non-negotiable requirement. Dutch and German language skills would be a plus- Strong understanding of vehicle body repair processes, including aluminum and steel welding, mechanical, electrical, trim and refinishing knowledge. Experience of electric vehicles repairs is strongly preferred- Strong facilitation, coaching, stakeholder management and interpersonal communication skills required- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, and demonstrated confidence and professionalism in working in a customer-facing role- Proactive, flexible, confident, professional, and self-directed in a fast-paced environment- Ability to travel at least 60% of the time, with a valid Driver’s License and a valid passport- Experience with environmental and safety requirements is a plusTesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.Privacy is a top priority for Tesla. We build it into our products and view it as an essential part of our business. To understand more about the data we collect and process as part of your application, please view our Tesla Talent Privacy Notice.Apply at: https://www.tesla.com/careers/search/job/284997?source=BA

SCHOTT Pharma designs solutions grounded in science to ensure that medications are safe and easy to use for people around the world - because human health matters. The portfolio comprises drug containment and delivery solutions for injectable drugs ranging from prefillable glass and polymer syringes, to cartridges, vials, and ampoules. Every day, a team of around 4,700 people from over 65 nations works at SCHOTT Pharma to contribute to global healthcare. The company is represented in all main pharmaceutical hubs with 17 manufacturing sites in Europe, North and South America, and Asia. With over 900 patents and technologies developed in-house, a state-of-the-art R&D center in Switzerland, and around 130 employees in R&D, the company is focused on developing innovations for the future. SCHOTT Pharma AG & Co. KGaA, headquartered in Mainz, Germany, is part of SCHOTT AG that is owned by the Carl Zeiss Foundation. In light of this spirit, SCHOTT Pharma is committed to sustainable development for society and the environment and has the strategic goal of becoming climate-neutral by 2030. Currently, SCHOTT Pharma has over 1,700 customers including the top 30 leading pharma manufacturers for injectable drugs and generated sales of EUR 650 million in the fiscal year 2021.About usHuman health matters.That is why SCHOTT Pharma designs science-based solutions to help ensure medicines are safe and easy to use for people around the world.As part of our digital transformation, SCHOTT Pharma is advancing its journey towards becoming a data-driven and AI-enabled organization.
